Backend: 45/45 pytest pass (20 new v46b + 24 v46 regression + 1 DPR). Frontend: invitations widget + vendor invite landing verified. FeeCharger tab wiring is BROKEN — MastersPanel.jsx never imports/mounts FeeCharger.jsx and the tabs array in it omits 'fees'. Users cannot reach the Charge Fee UI at all. issues: Console shows several React hydration errors: <span> as child of <option> and <button> as descendant of <button> — pre-existing since iteration_22, not introduced by v46b, but still noisy.

action_items: HIGH: Wire the Charge Fee tab in /app/frontend/src/apps/admin-console/MastersPanel.jsx — (a) `import FeeCharger from './masters/FeeCharger';`, (b) append `['fees', 'Charge Fee']` to the tabs tuple array on line 112, (c) add `{tab === 'fees' && <FeeCharger />}` after the existing tab branches. Component and backend are ready; this is a one-file wiring miss.

OPTIONAL: Fix hydration warnings — remove <span> from inside <option> in the mobile admin-tabs-select and stop nesting <button> inside a <button>/<label> (AnalyticsPanel / InfoDot). Long-standing noise since iteration_22.
critical_code_review_comments: Invitations backend endpoint `list_invitations` reads `v.get('id')` then falls back to `str(v.get('_id'))`, but participants collection stores vendor_id as the vendor `id` string (from vendor_auth). If a vendor doc has only `_id` and no `id` field, joined-status detection could return false-positive false. Verified working in production because vendor docs do carry `id`.

billing.py fee-checkout uses `str(request.base_url)` to build the webhook URL — inside the ingress this resolves to the internal 0.0.0.0:8001 host, not the public one. Stripe won't be able to call the webhook from the preview. Consider deriving from an explicit env var (PUBLIC_BASE_URL) or reflecting `req.origin_url`.

FeeCheckoutRequest allows `tender_value=0` (Field(0, ge=0)), which combined with a percentage slab produces amount=0 and returns 400. Better to raise 422 with 'tender_value required for percentage slabs' for clarity — current 400 message is generic.

AuctionInvitations widget stores tokens verbatim in the DOM (COPY LINK button copies /vendor/auction/invite/{token}); if a browser extension or logged UI event captures it, tokens leak. Consider single-use tokens or short expiry. Currently tokens are effectively permanent.

rca of the issue: FeeCharger tab miss: MastersPanel.jsx's tabs list was extended in the review request spec (masters-tab-fees) but the actual JSX at line 112 still holds only the original 7 tabs. FeeCharger.jsx was created as an orphan file — grep for 'FeeCharger' across /app/frontend/src returns only its own definition. Root cause: main agent generated the component and updated api.js but forgot the import + tab-case + array-entry patch to MastersPanel.jsx. Reproduction: log in as admin → click MASTERS → observe visible tabs (Staff Master / Companies / Tenants / Approval Matrix / Hierarchy / Rating & Fees / Investor Demo). No 'Charge Fee' tab. Confirmed by `grep -n 'fees' MastersPanel.jsx` → no match. Mitigation is a 3-line patch outlined in action_items.
